idea: Themed weeks, week four, Markets day: written from the source, then corrected by a numbers editor and a viewer editor before voicing.
description: In September 2025, mutual-fund assets recorded in Maharashtra were ₹60.2 for every ₹100 of bank deposits counted in the state at end-March 2025, the highest of 35 states and UTs with data. India's figure was ₹33.2. Gujarat, the next highest, was ₹43.2, and Telangana, near the middle, ₹15.3.

Maharashtra was also the highest in each of the three Septembers to 2025: ₹50 (2023), ₹59 and ₹60. Assets are from AMFI and deposits from RBI: two publishers, two dates. AMFI does not say how it assigns a state, and it revised its state list in March 2026; this uses the list before. AMFI's Factbook 2026 puts investors other than individuals at 52% of the fund assets recorded in Maharashtra in March 2026. Not per person.
source: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI), Classified Average AUM, State Wise: average assets of all mutual fund schemes, September 2025, on AMFI's state list before its March 2026 revision. RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States 2024-25, Table 155: bank deposits, end-March 2025, counted where the bank office is. Two publishers, two dates. AMFI's files do not say how a state is assigned; its Factbook 2026 (p. 51) puts non-individual investors at 52% of Maharashtra's assets, March 2026.
